scope: pyproj 3.8.0 with PROJ 9.9.0 and Python 3.12.15, POSIX isolated process, network disabled: WGS84 Geod.inv/Geod.fwd for bounded route chainage (|latitude| <= 75 on every path, legs and requested endpoint gap <= 5000 km, no antimeridian) with host-owned independent verification. Other pyproj or PROJ builds are refused, not assumed compatible.
acceptance: Run tools/qualify_pyproj.py with the isolated runtime; require the shared kit, baseline/variant independent expectations, domain and gap refusals, adequacy fault injection, hostile saved evidence, requirement outcomes, workflow reuse/invalidation, canonical export and in-flight timeout/cancel.
A new pyproj or PROJ build needs its own bounded native acceptance before absorbedVersion or the pinned runtime identity changes.
